answer: Unilever reported a 77% reduction in 2025 against the 2015 baseline for its absolute operational Scope 1 and 2 target. The target scope excludes all emissions from biogenic fuels and owned or leased vehicles controlled by Unilever, in line with the SBTi minimum scope requirement.
